apps/host keeps the @xeon/host/client re-export, its tests drive the host through the client connection (the X7 settings-file test also drives the model account view-model from ./accounts), and connectServiceTransport/attachToService/bridgeStdioToService use the client socket transport and endpoint grammar (adr.0020; open: adr.0020 section 3.5 says host does not import client).

Every L3 group (packages/group-<name>, group-kit excepted) uses the shared group definition helpers of group-kit through its entries "." and "./testing" only (review.decisions-2 U-15). Other group paths and other group-kit entries stay violations. The group templates (group-kit/templates) import the same entries.
The cross-group import test runs scripts/check-layers.ts on a fixture workspace and reads its DR-02 failure (L3.group-kit.plan G-21).
CLI scenario tests run the real xeon process and kill it to check resume (review.decisions-2 B-06).
Restart fault tests kill a real child process at commit fault points to check resume (review.decisions-2 B-06).
Fork record checks read the fork sources for process use patterns in test/fork-records.test.ts (review.decisions-2 B-06).
Desktop shell tests run the real sidecar process and talk to it over stdio (review.decisions-2 B-06, L4.desktop.plan D1).
The approval restart test runs a real stdio host process and kills it with SIGKILL while an approval waits, then resumes in a new host (m2-plan HOST.4 A1, review.decisions-2 B-06).
